text:
Not sure if it was intentional or not, but it’s interesting that this series’ premise is like a late franchise F13 sequel, where they throw Jason into a gimmick.
We’ve had “Jason in New York”, “Jason in Space”, “Jason as a body snatcher”, but now Pamela gets to play in a weird setting. “Pamela Voorhees in Stranger Things”.
I’m conflicted about the premise but I think I’ll be able to have fun with it if the gore and kills are there. That’s how I rationalized my way through the silly F13 sequels anyway.

text: I just finished watching Wonder Man, I was a little bit on the fence on starting it since I heard it was a little divisive. I ended up really liking it. Might even be in my top 3 Marvel shows. I'm not too familiar with Wonder Man so the amount it was true to the comics or the lack of big flashy fights didn't really bother me. Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Ben Kingsley were both amazing. And it's an unpopular opinion but I was a big fan of Ironman 3 so I loved the return of Kingsley as the "fake" Mandarin. I'd watch him in that role for hours. I'm sad it got cancelled, would have really liked to see more of Simon and Trevor's story. Maybe he'll show up in one of the movies but I would be surprised if he wasn't relegated to anything but a very small role. It's a shame.
